report:
Reviewed the complete meta.reviews.review_delegation claim, its one ordinary implementation association (review.rs PROMPT), and its one ordinary annotated test. Captured the complete review skill and reviews specification as additional dependencies. The normative behavior here is the instruction workflow, not enforcement that arbitrary agents actually obey it. The skill coordinator section explicitly requires one subagent per failing anchor, including TODO/N/A, supplies the anchor ID and initial start/printed-input instruction, restricts ownership to one agent per validation directory, permits different-anchor concurrency, forbids uncaptured source context, and records additional instructions with --instructions. Reviewer sections require captured reads and report recording. Coordinator follow-up requires reconciliation and coordinated changes, fresh start/read/record reviews for affected anchors, and cargo meta check again. The implementation PROMPT reinforces assigned-subagent ownership, exhaustive evaluation including TODO/N/A prerequisites, captured dependencies, recording and fresh starts after edits; inventory supplies this prompt to every review. The skill is captured explicitly because it is the operative non-Rust implementation of this process.

The original annotated test only checked disconnected words and command names. Strengthened that existing test to assert each delegation and ownership obligation in the coordinator section, read/record commands in reviewer sections, and reconciliation, affected-anchor fresh reviews and the subsequent check in follow-up. Whitespace normalization permits line wrapping changes; role scoping prevents incidental words elsewhere from satisfying the assertions. All claim clauses now have visible assertions in the sole associated test. There are no TODO/N/A evidence entries to justify; their workflow inclusion is directly asserted. No production behavioral defect was found or claimed. Ran cargo fmt, cargo test -p sage-meta --test review review_skill_assigns_one_owner_and_requires_start_read_record (1 passed), and cargo build (passed with existing sage-ir warnings). Started a fresh review after the test edit and inspected the refreshed claim/test/association inputs, then recaptured the skill and specification. Central delegated quality and Sage checks remain the coordinator's responsibility for the aggregate change; this report assesses only this anchor.
